messages.text: The Annapolis 20-inch Illuminated Antique Floor Globe is our top floor-standing pick — it's a large, hand-assembled, made-in-USA heirloom with a raised relief antique map that glows when lit, all on a handcrafted hardwood stand, so it makes a real centrepiece for a room. If you'd like the same floor-standing size with a crisp blue-ocean look instead, the Statesman 20-inch Illuminated Blue Ocean Floor Globe with Walnut Stand is a great fit too. You'll find the Annapolis under that exact name in search, ready to add to your cart.
